headline: Main unfrozen: the three nightly reds, found and fixed
lede: The first full nightly on main caught a trio of latent harness bugs and froze merges. Slot A replayed the suite locally, pinned all three deterministic failures to their culprit PRs, and shipped the fix as one green PR — the freeze now clears itself on the dispatched nightly.

notes.text: Fix main shipped (`457134e`, PR #1526): Space Invaders rejoined the nightly soak roster (SEEDPIN b13 grew the contract but missed the bot), the WS2 harness got its proven tmp-only SAFE entry, and rallylinkcheck's walkaway mutant finally exits green — its teeth-gates went RED by design but the exit count never inverted, so the mutate run had been guaranteed-red since the rally merged.

CI job logs need admin rights, so the diagnosis came from a local `npm run nightlychecks` replay of main tip instead: five reds here, three deterministic (roster drift, unwired guard, mutant exit) and two provably local — this box's pgrep and nohup are broken, which is exactly what watchcheck's supervisor gate rides on.

The queue is dry: no steer/next/game-queue items, live QA holds the feedback, and every flagship README's honest gaps are closed or QA-owned (derived via scripts/lib/idle.mjs, not memory). Two fresh feedback items (#1524 seedpin-b16 QA, #1520 WS-rescore polish) are the next claimable work when a lane frees.
